title: Tagine Chicken with Pistachio Crust
description: A flavorful North African-inspired dish with the rich flavors of a tagine, topped with a crunchy pistachio crust.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern or North African markets

instructions: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Heat the beurre in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and top with sliced polish sausage.
In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spice blend and noisette.
Sprinkle the spice blend mixture over the top of the chicken and sausage.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
